meta.name: implementing-api-security-posture-management
meta.description: Implement API Security Posture Management to continuously discover, classify, and score APIs based on risk while enforcing security policies across the API lifecycle.

copy.tagline: 持续发现、分类和评分 API 风险，自动执行安全策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 API 生命周期中的安全风险并自动实施防护策略
copy.tagline_en: Continuously discover, classify, and score API risks while enforcing security policies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage API security risks and automatically enforce policies across the API lifecycle

howto.what: Claude 会帮你自动发现所有 API（包括内部、外部、影子等），评估风险并打分，同时自动执行安全策略（如认证、加密、限流等），确保 API 生命周期安全。
howto.when: 当你要求实施 API 安全态势管理，或需要发现、分类、评估 API 风险时触发。

say.text: 帮我发现所有影子API并评估风险。

say.note: Claude会生成包含风险分布的报告。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you automatically discover all APIs (including internal, external, shadow), assess and score risks, and enforce security policies such as authentication, encryption, and rate limiting across the API lifecycle.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement API security posture management, or need to discover, classify, and assess API risks.

say_en.text: Discover all shadow APIs and assess their risks.
Enforce OAuth2 authentication for external APIs.
Generate an API security posture report.
say_en.note: Claude produces a report with risk distribution.
